faculty.name: Alexander G. Ophir
faculty.summary: Studies the roles of vasopressin and oxytocin in social recognition, attachment, aggression, and care-giving in prairie voles.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究催产素和血管加压素在原鼠社交识别、依恋、攻击性和抚育行为中的作用。

faculty.name: Khena M. Swallow
faculty.summary: Studies how attending to behaviorally relevant moments in time impacts attention and memory, using behavioral, eye tracking, and MRI data.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究行为相关时刻的注意和记忆影响，使用行为、眼动追踪和MRI数据。

faculty.name: Misha Ailsworth
faculty.summary: Studies the impact of families, communities, and schools on Black girls' mental health, using qualitative and participatory methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究家庭、社区和学校对黑人女孩心理健康的影响，采用质性研究和参与式方法。

faculty.name: Adam Anderson
faculty.summary: Studies the role of emotions in perception and moral judgment, integrating psychological and neural analysis.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究情绪在知觉和道德判断中的作用，结合心理和神经层面的分析。

faculty.name: John H. Blume
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive and social processes in legal contexts, focusing on the psychology of testimony and decision-making.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知和社会过程在法律环境中的作用，重点是证词和决策的心理学。

faculty.name: Charles Brainerd
faculty.summary: Studies how memory influences reasoning and vice versa, developing fuzzy-trace theory to explain counterintuitive aspects of human cognition.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究记忆如何影响推理以及反过来推理如何影响记忆，发展模糊痕迹理论来解释人类认知中的一些反直觉方面。

faculty.name: Anthony Burrow
faculty.summary: Studies the role of purpose in life and its impact on psychological adjustment and resilience, particularly among ethnic minorities.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究生活目的在心理调适和韧性中的作用，尤其是对少数民族群体的影响。

faculty.name: Daniel Casasanto
faculty.summary: Studies how linguistic, cultural, and bodily experiences influence cognition and decision-making, using various methods including fMRI, VR, and fieldwork.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究语言、文化和身体经验如何影响认知和决策，并使用多种方法，包括功能性磁共振成像、虚拟现实和实地研究。

faculty.name: Marianella Casasola
faculty.summary: Studies how infants and children develop spatial skills and learn language, using naturalistic and experimental methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究婴儿和儿童的空间技能发展和语言学习，使用自然观察和实验方法。

faculty.name: Stephen Ceci
faculty.summary: Studies children's testimonial competence, sex discrimination in science, and intellectual development across cultures.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童作证能力、科学领域中的性别歧视以及跨文化智力发展。

faculty.name: Morten H. Christiansen
faculty.summary: Studies the evolution, acquisition, and processing of language, focusing on the role of chunking and statistical learning.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究语言的进化、获得和处理，重点关注块状结构和统计学习的作用。

faculty.name: Thomas A. Cleland
faculty.summary: Studies how learning and memory shape sensory processing in the brain, using electrophysiology, pharmacology, and computational modeling.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究学习和记忆如何塑造大脑的感觉处理，使用电生理学、药理学和计算建模方法。

faculty.name: Audun Dahl
faculty.summary: Studies how moral reasoning and behavior develop across the lifespan, using experiments and observations with various age groups.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究道德推理和行为在生命周期中的发展，使用不同年龄段的实验和观察方法。

faculty.name: Eve De Rosa
faculty.summary: Studies the neurochemistry of attention and learning in rats and humans, using fMRI and pharmacology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究注意力和学习的神经化学机制，使用功能性磁共振成像和药理学方法，比较啮齿动物和人类。

faculty.name: Rachel Dunifon
faculty.summary: Studies the impact of policy and family settings on the development of less-advantaged children, focusing on maternal employment, family living arrangements, and grandparents' roles.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究政策和家庭环境对弱势儿童发展的影响，重点关注母亲就业、家庭居住安排和祖父母的作用。

faculty.name: Shimon Edelman
faculty.summary: Studies the evolution and consciousness of life forms, from amoeba to humans, with a focus on climate change.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究生命形式（从原生动物到人类）的进化和意识，并重点关注气候变化。

faculty.name: Gary Evans
faculty.summary: Studies how the physical environment affects children's health and well-being, focusing on poverty, housing, and schools.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究物理环境如何影响儿童的健康和福祉，重点关注贫困、住房和学校。

faculty.name: David J. Field
faculty.summary: Studies sensory coding and visual perception, exploring how the structure of the natural environment is represented by sensory systems.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究感觉编码和视觉知觉，探索自然环境结构如何被感觉系统表征。

faculty.name: Thomas D. Gilovich
faculty.summary: Studies social psychology phenomena, including decision-making and social behavior.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会心理学现象，包括决策和社交行为。

faculty.name: Michael H. Goldstein
faculty.summary: Studies how infants learn to talk, focusing on vocal learning and development in songbirds and human infants, using social and statistical mechanisms.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究婴儿如何学习说话，通过鸟类和人类婴儿的鸣叫学习和发展，使用社会和统计机制。

faculty.name: Marlen Gonzalez
faculty.summary: Studies how social and physical environments impact neural sensitivity to rewards, punishment, vigilance, and stress, using psychophysiology, neuroimaging, and spatial analysis.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会和物理环境如何影响奖赏、惩罚、警觉性和压力的神经敏感性，使用心理生理学、神经成像和空间分析方法。

faculty.name: Will Hobbs
faculty.summary: Develops statistical methods to analyze public attitudes towards government policies, focusing on the Affordable Care Act.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发统计方法分析公众对政府政策的态度，重点是《平价医疗法案》。

faculty.name: Adam J. Hoffman
faculty.summary: Studies how social identities develop and change in adolescence, their relation to mental health, and how to leverage them for positive youth development.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究青少年时期的社会身份如何发展和变化，它们与心理健康的关系，以及如何利用这些身份促进青少年的积极发展。

faculty.name: Nori Jacoby
faculty.summary: Studies how internal representations of sensory and cognitive abilities are shaped by nature and nurture, using machine learning and large-scale experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究感觉和认知能力内部表征如何由先天和后天因素塑造，使用机器学习和大规模实验。

faculty.name: Corinna Loeckenhoff
faculty.summary: Studies age differences in time horizons, personality, and emotional experience, and their impact on health.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究不同年龄段的时间视野、人格和情绪体验及其对健康的影响。

faculty.name: Jane Mendle
faculty.summary: Studies the transition from childhood to adolescence, focusing on how puberty and its perception affect mental health.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究从儿童期到青春期的过渡，关注青春期及其感知如何影响心理健康。

faculty.name: Anthony Ong
faculty.summary: Studies how emotions and social connections affect health and development across the lifespan, using longitudinal methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究情绪和社会联系如何影响从成年到老年的健康和发展，使用纵向研究方法。

faculty.name: Gordon Pennycook
faculty.summary: Studies reasoning and decision-making, focusing on the causes and consequences of analytic thinking and its importance in decision processes.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究推理和决策过程，关注分析性思维的原因及其后果，并探讨其在决策中的重要性。

faculty.name: Karl Pillemer
faculty.summary: Studies aging and family social networks, focusing on the life course and health policy.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究老化和家庭社会网络，关注生命周期和健康政策。

faculty.name: David A. Pizarro
faculty.summary: Studies moral judgment and the influence of emotions on moral intuitions, using psychological experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究道德判断及其情绪影响，采用心理学实验方法。

faculty.name: Nora H. Prior
faculty.summary: Studies the development of cognitive functions in humans.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类认知功能的发展。

faculty.name: David Rand
faculty.summary: Studies how AI chatbots can influence voters' attitudes and behaviors, aiming to restore trust in digital public spheres.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究AI聊天机器人如何影响选民的态度和行为，旨在恢复数字公共领域的信任。

faculty.name: Valerie Reyna
faculty.summary: Studies judgment and decision making, particularly dual processes, false memory, and their implications for risky decisions in various fields.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究判断与决策过程，尤其是双过程理论、错误记忆及其对法律、健康、医学和神经科学中风险决策的影响。

faculty.name: Jonathan A. Rottenberg
faculty.summary: Studies long-term well-being after depression, focusing on factors that predict good outcomes.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究抑郁症后的长期福祉，重点关注预测良好结果的因素。

faculty.name: Jessica M. Salerno
faculty.summary: Studies how cognitive, emotional, and social processes affect legal judgments, especially in courtrooms, to improve justice systems.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知、情感和社会过程如何影响法庭判决，以改进司法制度。

faculty.name: David M. Smith
faculty.summary: Studies learning and memory processes in rodents using neural recordings and pharmacological manipulations.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究啮齿动物的学习和记忆过程，使用神经记录和药理学操纵方法。

faculty.name: Robert Sternberg
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive and emotional processes, including creativity, intelligence, and expertise, using psychological assessments and theories.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知和情绪过程，包括创造力、智力和专业知识，使用心理评估和理论。

faculty.name: Felix J. Thoemmes
faculty.summary: Develops software for regression-discontinuity designs and applies causal inference methods in developmental and health psychology.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发回归连续性设计软件并应用因果推断方法于发展和健康心理学。

faculty.name: Katherine Tschida
faculty.summary: Studies the neural circuits underlying mouse vocalizations, focusing on social context, brainstem neuron coordination, and communication signals.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究小鼠鸣叫的神经回路，关注社会背景、脑干神经元协调和沟通信号。

faculty.name: Qi Wang
faculty.summary: Studies the development of cognitive and social-cognitive skills, including autobiographical memory and future thinking, in the context of culture.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究文化背景下认知和社会认知技能的发展，包括自传体记忆和未来思考。

faculty.name: Jenna Wells
faculty.summary: Studies how emotion in close relationships affects mental and physical health in late life, focusing on caregivers of those with neurodegenerative diseases.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究亲密关系中的情绪如何影响晚年的心身健康，特别是照顾神经退行性疾病患者的护理人员。

faculty.name: Wendy Williams
faculty.summary: Studies the development and assessment of intelligence and cognitive performance in real-world contexts, focusing on promoting women in science and encouraging underrepresented groups to pursue.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究智力和认知表现的发展与评估，特别是在现实世界中的应用，重点关注促进女性从事科学研究，并鼓励少数群体从事科学教育和职业。

faculty.name: Jordan C. Wylie
faculty.summary: Studies how morality, norms, and rules influence social cognition, using surveys, behavioral experiments, and neuroimaging.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究道德、规范和规则如何影响社会认知，使用调查、行为实验和神经成像方法。

faculty.name: Vivian Zayas
faculty.summary: Studies how people form and maintain relationships, using implicit processes, EEG/ERP, fMRI, and self-reports.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人们如何形成和维持关系，使用隐性过程、EEG/ERP、fMRI 和自我报告。

faculty.name: John Blume
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive development in children, focusing on memory and learning processes.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童的认知发展，重点关注记忆和学习过程。

faculty.name: Adam Hoffman
faculty.summary: Studies how social identities develop and change in adolescence, their relation to mental health, and how to leverage these identities to promote positive youth development.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究青少年时期社会身份的发展变化及其与心理健康的关系，以及如何利用这些身份促进青少年的积极发展。

faculty.name: Jessica Salerno
faculty.summary: Studies how cognitive, emotional, and social processes affect legal judgments, especially in courtrooms, to improve justice systems.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知、情感和社会过程如何影响法庭判决，以改进司法制度。

faculty.name: Felix Thoemmes
faculty.summary: Develops and evaluates statistical tools for causal inference and missing data analysis, applying these methods to social science data.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发和评估因果推断和缺失数据分析的统计工具，并将这些方法应用于社会科学数据。
